title: canon project config
description: Per-project settings for the canon Claude Code plugin, written by /canon:setup to .claude/canon.json. Every hook and skill reads branch names, commands and URLs from here; nothing is hardcoded.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so editors can validate and document the file.

version.description: Config format version. Bumped only by a breaking change to this schema.

owner.description: The person who approves specs and merges releases into production. Named in skill prompts and hook messages, e.g. "ask Ada".

branches.description: The two protected branches, and the prefixes feature branches take.

integration.description: Where finished work lands, e.g. "staging". Feature branches are cut from it and merge into it. /canon:staging merges here once CI is green. No direct edits or pushes.

production.description: What ships, e.g. "main". It changes only through the release pull request from the integration branch, which only the owner merges. Must differ from integration; single-branch repositories are not supported yet.

prefixes.description: Allowed feature branch prefixes, without the slash, e.g. ["feat", "fix", "chore", "refactor", "docs"]. A branch is <prefix>/<kebab-case-slug>.

packageManager.description: The package manager the project uses, e.g. "pnpm", "npm", "yarn", "bun", or "none". Used when a skill needs to run a script or install a dependency.

commands.description: The local gate, run by /canon:build, /canon:review and /canon:staging before a pull request leaves draft or merges. Each is a shell command, or null when the project has no such check. A null check is reported as absent, never treated as a pass.

format.description: The format check, not the fixer, e.g. "pnpm format:check".

formatFile.description: The formatter the PostToolUse hook runs on each file Claude edits, as an argv list, e.g. ["pnpm", "exec", "prettier", "--write", "--ignore-unknown"]. The file path is appended as the last argument and the command runs with no shell. It runs only after the owner approves this exact command for this project in /canon:setup, which records the approval in ~/.claude/canon/trusted.json, outside the repository; a changed command is not run until it is approved again. null disables it.

urls.description: Where each build is served, quoted in hand-backs. null when there is none.

preview.description: Per-branch preview URL pattern, with {branch} replaced by the branch name, e.g. "https://{branch}.preview.example.com". null when feature branches get no preview deployment, which the skills then say rather than hunting for one.

staging.description: Where the integration branch is served, e.g. "https://staging.example.com".

production.description: Where the production branch is served, e.g. "https://example.com".

tracker.description: Optional. When set, the issue tracker is the record and the gate: each command reads and sets the issue's status, and the spec's **Status:** line mirrors it. Leave it out to gate on the spec file alone.

provider.description: The tracker: "linear". "fixture" is a tracker held in .claude/tracker-fixture.json, for tests and evals; it needs no key and reaches no network, and /canon:setup does not offer it.

team.description: The team key, the prefix of every issue identifier, e.g. "ABC" for ABC-123.

statuses.description: canon's lifecycle roles mapped to this team's status names, which differ per team. Each role needs a different status. /canon:setup offers the team's real names.

ready.description: Prioritised and waiting for a spec. /canon:define refuses a new spec on an issue in any other status.

spec.description: Being specced. /canon:define sets it when it starts; the issue rests here until approved.

approved.description: The owner approved the spec. /canon:approve sets it, after the spec is pushed. /canon:build refuses anything else, except blocked.

building.description: Being built. /canon:build sets it when it starts, and again when it resumes from blocked.

blocked.description: Claude is waiting on the owner, and nothing else. /canon:build and /canon:ship set it at a stop condition and post the question as a comment.

staging.description: Merged into the integration branch. Set by the tracker's GitHub integration on that merge, never by canon.

production.description: Merged into production. Set by the tracker's GitHub integration on the release merge, never by canon.

labelPrefix.description: Prefix of the labels that route an issue to its canon file: auth.md is <prefix>auth. /canon:define adds the missing ones and never creates a label.

apiKeyCommand.description: A command that prints the API key, as an argv list run with no shell, e.g. ["op", "read", "op://Vault/Item/field"]. Tried after LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment and in .env.local. It runs only after the owner approves this exact command for this project in /canon:setup, recorded in ~/.claude/canon/trusted.json like formatFile. null or absent: no command.
